summary: Iteration 62 - Financial Features Campus Filter Tests. All backend and frontend tests passed. Financial nav is visible on 'All Locations' for admin users. Financial data (donations, expenses, products, sales) correctly auto-sets location_id on creation and respects campus filter on retrieval.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 62 financial campus filter features verified: (1) Financial nav is visible on 'All Locations' for admin users - Layout.jsx line 268 changed condition from '(!activeCampus && !isAdmin)' to 'activeCampus && !campusFeatures.financial_enabled'. (2) GET /api/financial/summary applies campus filter via get_campus_filter() for all aggregations (monthly + cumulative). (3) GET /api/financial/cashflow applies campus filter to each month's queries. (4) POST /api/financial/donations auto-sets location_id from user's active_campus_id or location_id when not provided. (5) POST /api/financial/expenses auto-sets location_id similarly. (6) POST /api/products auto-sets location_id. (7) POST /api/sales auto-sets location_id. (8) GET /api/financial/donations and expenses respect campus filter. Admin user has active_campus_id=loc_001 (58:12 Global Central). Dashboard shows financial summary cards (Monthly Donations, Monthly Expenses, Net Balance). Financial page shows Cashflow Overview chart and Donation Records table.
